bridge_unlocks.design_signal: ModelBridge binds model_output + proof/model hashes + bounds + timestamp into a Groth16 public-signal commitment that policy lanes can enforce.
bridge_unlocks.unlock: Model output -> policy gate, not just model output -> score
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Lets AI recommendations become cryptographically gateable execution intents.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: Bridge lane can consume zkML-style artifacts, format calldata for Garaga, then target Starknet verification paths.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: De-risks lock-in to a single proving stack while keeping one policy interface.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: The same intent can flow through SNARK (Groth16/Garaga) and STARK (integrity/SNOS-style) lanes with mirror status tracking.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Allows product-level trust modes instead of one hardcoded proof lane.

bridge_unlocks.design_signal: Bridge proofs feed strategy gating while shielded/nullifier/relayer rails preserve user privacy and selective disclosure.
bridge_unlocks.why_it_matters: Supports private capital ops without losing verifiable safety checks.
